Have you ever found yourself staring at a to-do list, knowing exactly what needs to get done… but just not quite able to start? That daily push-and-pull between what we intend to do and what actually happens can feel like a real tug-of-war, can’t it? Procrastination is something almost all of us wrestle with—even when we’re motivated and ready to tackle big goals.
Together, we’re about to explore why this happens. We’ll lean on insights from Piers Steel, whose book, The Procrastination Equation: How to Stop Putting Things Off and Start Getting Stuff Done, digs deep into the psychology behind our delays. Steel unpacks how motivation, impulsiveness, and time management swirl together in our minds, shaping the way we work—or don’t work—each day.
Along the way, we’ll look at the science, hear real stories, and pick up practical strategies that can actually make a difference. Why do things like fear of failure, perfectionism, or the temptation of quick rewards have such a hold on us? And more importantly, how can we break free so our actions finally match our intentions?
If you’ve ever wondered what really drives procrastination—and how to shift those patterns for good—you’re in the right place. Let’s take this journey together, uncover the hidden forces at play, and discover a new roadmap for turning your plans into real progress.
